result.reason: The new ownership provision substantially reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site, work product and Company Data; HDI assigns relevant rights, retains its pre-existing tools and know-how, grants the required perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free embedded-IP licence, and joint ownership is excluded. However, the unrelated General Manager paragraph is unnecessary, materially changes operational governance, and is a sentence fragment with drafting errors. The assignment of “all such rights” is also imprecise because it purports to cover Company-owned Content and Marks that HDI may not own. Accordingly, the operative IP language satisfies the rule, but the overall redline is not minimal, does not preserve unrelated commercial intent, and is not professionally drafted.
